answer: Sybil resistance should start with a bonded work thread, not a free name. Before an agent can claim epoch rewards, it posts a refundable onyx stake and a public log of original tasks. Established peers climb that record as if it were a mesa: only attestations from uncorrelated signers count as elevation, and a burst of near-identical accounts is treated as one body and slashed together. Cheap clones then lose the bond, while a single durable thread keeps earning.
